title: LessonScript
tagline: A small worksheet language with exact fractions.
inspiration: Teachers need repeatable arithmetic worksheets with understandable errors and exact answers, without executing arbitrary program code.
whatItDoes: Compiles a tiny language of titles, exercises and comments into a printable worksheet. It evaluates fractional arithmetic exactly, reports source-line errors and supports source export and owned saves.
howItWasBuilt: A bounded TypeScript parser handles precedence, unary operators and parentheses. BigInt rational arithmetic avoids floating-point rounding. Next.js supplies the editor and print view; PostgreSQL supports saved work.
technicalEvidence: Local automated verification is included in this repository. Real provider calls, cloud deployment and browser end-to-end verification remain pending.
authorship: Prepared with ChatGPT/Codex assistance. Shared Next.js/workspace infrastructure originates in code-up-matrix/axios-fx-compliance-agent; the product module was developed on 27 October 2026. Shared code must be disclosed under the event’s reuse rules.
eligibility: A custom language is required. Overview says students only while rules say 16+ generally; resolve conflict. Source and demo video up to five minutes.
judgeAccessInstructions: Provide the private judging access code through the submission portal after live verification. Do not put it in public source.
challenges: The language must remain small and predictable while rejecting JavaScript, division by zero, excessive nesting and oversized input.
accomplishments: Nine standalone tests and the production build pass, including exact arithmetic and source diagnostics. Classroom outcomes and deployed saving have not been measured.
lessons: A domain-specific language earns its value through a precise grammar and useful diagnostics, not the number of general-purpose features it exposes.
next: Resolve the conflicting student eligibility language, verify the deployed save flow and record a demonstration of the language and its implementation.
judgeFit: Implements an actual custom language with a concrete educational use, parser and exact evaluator. Eligibility must be clarified before submission; the demo must remain within five minutes.
demo: Introduce the grammar with a short worksheet.
Compile expressions with exact fractional answers.
